title: Check the phones in at shift end
purpose: Every phone is back, checked, counted, on charge, and waiting for the review.
with: the Portfolio Manager, who checks the count
when: 4:00 PM, every shift. The review starts at 5:00 PM.
takes: About an hour for ten phones.

steps.do: Stop every phone before any hat comes off.
Collect each phone from its own wearer.
steps.check: Every log line has phone, cap, and mount back.

steps.do: Tick screen, port, mount, and battery.
steps.detail: Note what broke and how. Write full for any storage warning.
steps.check: Four ticks or a note per phone.

steps.do: Count every phone against this morning's number.
steps.detail: Spares included. Write it with the time.

steps.do: Dock every phone, one per cable.
At a hub site, write tonight's run lists.
steps.detail: Full and broken phones on the first run.
steps.check: No run holds more than a third of the phones.

steps.do: Hand over to the Portfolio Manager.
steps.detail: The sheet, the log, and what you saw today.
steps.check: They know every full, broken, or short phone.

steps.do: Clock out with nothing in your bag.
steps.check: You leave first. The Portfolio Manager locks the room.

done: By 5:00 PM every phone is back, counted, on charge, and the Portfolio Manager has the sheet.

fails.then: Ask its wearer. Call the Portfolio Manager before anyone goes home. Lost mode within the hour.
Note what broke. If it powers on, its footage still uploads tonight. A spare goes out tomorrow.

fails.if: A phone shows a storage warning
fails.then: It uploads first and does not go out until zero pending.

fails.if: The router or the power is down
fails.then: Dock anyway. Call the Portfolio Manager now. No upload tonight means a hub run before 11 PM.
Write who signed for each phone and who returned it. Tell the Portfolio Manager at the handover.

escalate: Your Portfolio Manager, before anyone goes home; no reply in 20 minutes, call Moharam
